roadmaps_type_config_check.name: roadmaps_type_config_check
roadmaps_type_config_check.value:
(
        ("quills"."roadmaps"."type" = 'column' AND "quills"."roadmaps"."date_source" IS NULL AND "quills"."roadmaps"."frequency" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("quills"."roadmaps"."type" = 'date' AND "quills"."roadmaps"."date_source" = 'eta' AND "quills"."roadmaps"."frequency" IS NOT NULL)
      )

conversations_snoozed_until_idx.name: conversations_snoozed_until_idx
conversations_snoozed_until_idx.where: status = 'snoozed' AND snoozed_until IS NOT NULL

conversations_sla_unsettled_idx.name: conversations_sla_unsettled_idx
conversations_sla_unsettled_idx.where: sla_applied IS NOT NULL AND ((sla_applied ->> 'firstResponseAt') IS NULL OR (sla_applied ->> 'resolvedAt') IS NULL OR ((sla_applied ->> 'nextResponseDueAt') IS NOT NULL AND (sla_applied ->> 'nextResponseAt') IS NULL))

teams_is_default_idx.name: teams_is_default_idx
teams_is_default_idx.where: is_default = true AND deleted_at IS NULL

tickets_sla_unsettled_idx.name: tickets_sla_unsettled_idx
tickets_sla_unsettled_idx.where: "quills"."tickets"."sla_applied" IS NOT NULL AND ("quills"."tickets"."sla_applied" ->> 'resolvedAt') IS NULL

ticket_types_one_default_per_category_uq.name: ticket_types_one_default_per_category_uq
ticket_types_one_default_per_category_uq.where: is_default = true AND deleted_at IS NULL

channel_accounts_one_inbound_uq.name: channel_accounts_one_inbound_uq
channel_accounts_one_inbound_uq.where: role = 'inbound' AND channel = 'email' AND deleted_at IS NULL

channel_accounts_one_github_connection_u.name: channel_accounts_one_github_connection_uq
channel_accounts_one_github_connection_u.where: role = 'connection' AND channel = 'github' AND deleted_at IS NULL

channel_accounts_sending_address_uq.name: channel_accounts_sending_address_uq
channel_accounts_sending_address_uq.where: address IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

sla_events_subject_check.name: sla_events_subject_check
sla_events_subject_check.value: "quills"."sla_events"."conversation_id" IS NOT NULL OR "quills"."sla_events"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL

in_app_notifications_principal_unread_id.name: in_app_notifications_principal_unread_idx
in_app_notifications_principal_unread_id.where: read_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL

generated.as: setweight(to_tsvector(CASE locale WHEN 'de' THEN 'german'::regconfig WHEN 'fr' THEN 'french'::regconfig WHEN 'es' THEN 'spanish'::regconfig WHEN 'ar' THEN 'arabic'::regconfig WHEN 'ru' THEN 'russian'::regconfig WHEN 'nl' THEN 'dutch'::regconfig WHEN 'pt-br' THEN 'portuguese'::regconfig WHEN 'zh-cn' THEN 'simple'::regconfig WHEN 'zh-tw' THEN 'simple'::regconfig ELSE 'english'::regconfig END, coalesce(title, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector(CASE locale WHEN 'de' THEN 'german'::regconfig WHEN 'fr' THEN 'french'::regconfig WHEN 'es' THEN 'spanish'::regconfig WHEN 'ar' THEN 'arabic'::regconfig WHEN 'ru' THEN 'russian'::regconfig WHEN 'nl' THEN 'dutch'::regconfig WHEN 'pt-br' THEN 'portuguese'::regconfig WHEN 'zh-cn' THEN 'simple'::regconfig WHEN 'zh-tw' THEN 'simple'::regconfig ELSE 'english'::regconfig END, coalesce(content, '')), 'B')

job_queue_lease_shape_check.name: job_queue_lease_shape_check
job_queue_lease_shape_check.value: ("quills"."job_queue"."status" = 'running') = ("quills"."job_queue"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "quills"."job_queue"."locked_until" IS NOT NULL)
